confidence_notes: Overall low. Beer, coffee and meal anchors use Numbeo's Beijing crowd-sourced means (about 1,400 submissions, refreshed June 2026). Beer is set at ¥10, a little above Numbeo's ¥8 draught mean. Midrange uses Numbeo's ¥200 for two, and Western-style venues may cost more. Cocktail and wine_glass are judgement values set off the ¥10 beer price (about 7.5x and 5.5x) and checked against sparse Beijing figures. Accommodation is weakest: aggregator averages conflict, several figures are undated, and nothing is specific to July. CNY converted at about 6.77 per USD (Numbeo-implied). FX came from RBA search excerpts; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; Beijing-specific figures only. A national-average cheap-meal figure (about $10) was excluded because its own source flags it as not Beijing-specific.
